summary: Fast focused independent review of the updated Release Intelligence v2.0.0-GA GOLDEN BUILD ZIP SHA256 f63b3f32a97db990cfd37dea84f60218e6b751d05852429ecb104046a4d79e64. All 30 packaged files byte-match source. An existing Project/Measure now satisfies mapping without requiring Method or Google access; manual fallback requires a measure only when needed. Executive-v2 generation uses original engineer evidence plus month-scoped work evidence, permits one correction, and exposes only supported AI prose as copyable output; rejected or unavailable output stays in collapsed diagnostics instead of raw fallback text. Undated accomplishments cannot establish an explicit review-month achievement. Expanded-detail status visibility is separately validated and shared, defaults unchecked, and the identified preference-loss issue is fixed by preserving it during release edits. Parent statuses and requested DOM ordering remain intact. Independently executed all eight focused clean-executive tests successfully. No blocking issues remain. Overall application risk remains High under the existing rubric assessment.
caveats: Method is intentionally optional. Project/Measure is authoritative when present, while manual measure confirmation remains an explicitly declared fallback tied to the configured reference.

Undated evidence can support an unqualified accomplishment but cannot prove when it occurred. Temporal and factual checks remain linguistic heuristics; human review of chronology, goals, phases, status, and coverage remains necessary.

Only ready AI paragraphs are displayed and copied as executive prose. Blocked, rejected, or unavailable epics can be omitted from that prose; users must inspect the collapsed generation details for gaps before sharing.

Fresh work evidence adds model context and request cost. Large work histories, unavailable status fields, host limits, or model-output validation can still prevent a complete summary; no production-scale or production-model guarantee is made.

Existing append-only preservation semantics, shared-field concurrency, strict goal/Path-to-Green gates, usage completeness, preview caching/cancellation, journal growth, non-atomic updates, host/catalog/history limits, AllUsers sharing, Slack prepare/copy-only and unverified native paste, and unavailable live list-column metadata caveats remain.

This was a fast focused source/artifact review with eight independently executed targeted tests. The implementing agent reported the combined browser checks passed for copy output, SDK correction, measure-only operation, headers, preference reload, tile/tab order, and absence of KPI/context noise. Those browser checks and actual native/SDK production-model, hosted-browser, authenticated Google, remote publication, or golden-tag behavior were not independently verified. No broad/full suite was run.
